name: Entity Save And Add Another
description: Create a button on entity form that allows to create a entity content and continue to create another entity content of that type.
project_description:
This module adds "Save and Add Another" button to entities, that permits you to create an entity content and then continue to create another entity content.

 This module is very useful to content editors, as they don't have been redirected to the content listing page after adding the content, rather this module will allow them to create content one by one faster.

 This module currently supports Node, Taxonomy, Menu, Media and Block Entities . Other entities will be added soon.
